description: White Mercedes-AMG CLS 63 four-door coupe in Mullingar. The facelift W218 CLS 63 AMG used AMG's 5.5-litre (5,461 cc) V8 biturbo, quoted at 410 kW (557 hp) and 720 Nm on the standard car, or 430 kW (585 hp) and 800 Nm on the S-Model. All were fitted with the AMG SPEEDSHIFT MCT seven-speed sports transmission. A rear-wheel-drive version was sold, and 4MATIC, quoted with a 33:67 front-to-rear split, was optional on the standard car and standard on the S-Model. Quoted 0-100 km/h figures were 4.2 seconds for the rear-wheel-drive coupe, 3.7 seconds with 4MATIC and 3.6 seconds for the S-Model 4MATIC, with top speed limited to 250 km/h. This listing does not record which output or drivetrain this car has.
note: Images are renders approved by Eduard

description: 2015 BMW 7 Series 730d, reg 152-G-3708. White four-door saloon, automatic, with leather seats, in Mullingar. The 730d sold from late 2015 (G11) is a 3.0-litre straight-six diesel with 265 PS (195 kW) and 620 Nm, driving through an eight-speed automatic. BMW's quoted combined consumption for that engine was 4.5 L/100 km, with 0–100 km/h in 6.1 seconds. A standard 730d saloon was listed with leather, climate control and iDrive; M Sport and Exclusive were extra packs and are not assumed on this car.
priceBasis: Set by Eduard (EMD), 24 Nov 2026. Dealer-ad note, not the figure used: median of 11 RWD 730d saloon dealer ads on DoneDeal and Carzone, 2014–2016 because exact 2015 had 2 dealer ads, median €15,950, range €14,950 to €22,950. Private sellers and the one 730d xDrive were left out.

description: 2014 Hyundai i40 CRDi Blue, reg 141-G-5870. White four-door saloon, manual, with leather seats and a glass sunroof, in Mullingar. The 1.7 CRDi Blue Drive saloon used a 1,685 cc diesel. The 115 hp version was quoted at 115 hp and 260 Nm, about 5.1 L/100 km combined and 0–100 km/h in 12.3 seconds. A 136 hp tune was sold as well, and this listing does not say which one it is. Air conditioning and electric windows were standard; alloys, cruise control and leather varied by trim, so only the leather and sunroof recorded on this car are treated as fitted.
priceBasis: Median of 5 DoneDeal dealer ads for 2014 Hyundai i40 1.7 diesel that are saloons or not labelled as estates (John Carew, Fonthill Cars and Killanure Cars confirmed saloons; John Culhane and JJCA Motors not labelled estate). Estates left out. Median €5,950, range €5,450 to €6,995. Checked 24 Nov 2026. Carzone estate ads were not used.

description: 2011 BMW 5 Series 520d (F10), reg 11-WH-3227. Black four-door saloon, 2.0 diesel, manual, with cream leather seats, in Mullingar. The F10 520d used a 1,995 cc four-cylinder diesel with 184 hp and 380 Nm. With the six-speed manual, the quoted combined consumption was 4.5 L/100 km; the eight-speed automatic was quoted at 5.2 L/100 km and 0–100 km/h in 8.1 seconds. SE cars came with air conditioning, alloy wheels and iDrive. Leather was often an option, so the cream leather is taken from this listing rather than from the standard spec.
priceBasis: Median of 7 dealer ads for BMW 520d on DoneDeal and CarsIreland, 2010–2011, because exact-2011 ads confirmed as saloons were only 2. Titles that say touring or F11 were left out. Four are confirmed saloons (Derek Considine, O'Connell Automotive, Motorline, ABC Premier Motors); three 2011 dealer ads do not state the body. Private sellers excluded. Median €5,950, range €3,950 to €8,950. Checked 24 Nov 2026.

description: 2016 Volkswagen Passat estate, reg 161-D-14616. Blue five-door diesel automatic with leather seats, in Mullingar. The engine size is not recorded, so it could be the 1.6 TDI or the 2.0 TDI; both were sold as estates with a manual gearbox or DSG automatic. Comfortline and Highline changed the wheels, the media system and the driver aids, so economy and the exact standard kit depend on the version.
priceBasis: Median of 6 dealer ads for Volkswagen Passat diesel estates on DoneDeal, 2015–2017, because exact-2016 estate diesel dealer ads were only 3 (DN Trade Sales, Finch Motors, Green Mile Motors). Also Troy Car Sales and Centre Park Motors (2015) and Reddy 2 Drive (2017, title marked EST). Petrol, Alltrack/4Motion and ads that do not say estate were left out. Private sellers excluded. Median €8,900, range €5,780 to €15,900. Checked 24 Nov 2026. Engine of this car is not recorded, so 1.6 and 2.0 diesels are both in the set.

description: 2017 Ford Transit, reg 171-D-43912. White van with a fridge unit, in Mullingar. Fuel, gearbox and engine size are not recorded. The full-size Transit panel van of that year was commonly sold with a 2.2 TDCi diesel in more than one power output, and a fridge unit is an added body, not part of the standard van. Roof height, wheelbase and payload are not recorded, so they are not stated here.
priceBasis: No 2017 refrigerated Transit dealer ad found on DoneDeal, Carzone or CarsIreland. A 2017 2.2 panel-van set was too thin to price: the search mixed crew cabs, minibuses and a 4x4, with one franchise panel van (Navan Ford, €13,950 plus VAT) and one high-mileage LWB (Daniel Motors, €5,999). Price left blank rather than padded. Checked 24 Nov 2026.

description: 2009 Peugeot 308, reg 09-LM-3440. Blue five-door manual hatchback, in Mullingar. The engine and trim are not recorded. The first 308 was sold as a hatchback with petrol and diesel engines, in trims from Access up to GT. Performance, economy and equipment all depend on the version, which this listing does not give.
priceBasis: Median of 3 dealer ads for Peugeot 308 hatchbacks on DoneDeal, 2009–2010, because a 2009 dealer ad was only 1 (Trader, Tipperary, €2,495). Also LPC Motors 2010 (€1,995) and Duffy Auto Services 2010 (€4,950). Convertibles (308 CC) and private sellers excluded. Median €2,495, rounded to €2,500. Range €1,995 to €4,950. Sample is thin. Checked 24 Nov 2026.

description: 2011 Nissan Qashqai, reg 11-OY-1370. Grey manual SUV, in Mullingar. The engine and trim are not recorded. Cars of this generation in Ireland were commonly a 1.5 dCi diesel or a 1.6 petrol, in trims such as XE, n-tec and Tekna. The longer Qashqai+2 was a separate model and is not assumed. Equipment and economy depend on the version.
priceBasis: Median of 5 dealer ads for 2011 Nissan Qashqai (not the +2) on DoneDeal and Carzone: A.C Motors €2,650, M.W.M Value Vehicles €2,750, Kells Car Sales €2,750, IC Cars €2,995, JRCS LTD €5,999 (2.0 diesel 4x4 auto). Private sellers and Qashqai+2 excluded. Exact year had 5 ads, so 2012 was not added. Median €2,750, range €2,650 to €5,999. Checked 24 Nov 2026.

description: 2004 BMW X5, reg 04-G-4109. Black SUV, in Mullingar. The engine, gearbox and trim are not recorded. This year's X5 is the E53, which was sold with petrol and diesel engines until the E70 replaced it in 2006. Power, economy and equipment depend on the version.
priceBasis: Too thin to price. DoneDeal for BMW X5, 2003–2005, showed one dealer ad (Reddy 2 Drive, 2005 3.0 petrol, €2,500) and private ads, including 4.8is petrol. No 2004 dealer diesel. Price left blank rather than padded. Checked 24 Nov 2026.

description: 2012 Nissan Qashqai, 12 reg. SUV, in Mullingar. The engine, gearbox, colour and trim are not recorded. Cars of this generation were commonly a 1.5 dCi diesel or a 1.6 petrol, in trims such as XE, n-tec and Tekna. The Qashqai+2 was a separate seven-seat model and is not assumed. Equipment and economy depend on the version.
priceBasis: Median of 8 dealer ads for Nissan Qashqai (not the +2) on DoneDeal and Carzone. Exact 2012 dealer ads were 3 (DOS Motors €3,495, Cronin Autos €4,695, Direct Line Motors €5,495), so 2011 dealer ads were added: A.C Motors €2,650, M.W.M €2,750, Kells Car Sales €2,750, IC Cars €2,995, JRCS €5,999. Qashqai+2, private sellers and a €1 placeholder excluded. Median €3,245, rounded to €3,250. Range €2,650 to €5,999. Checked 24 Nov 2026.

description: 2012 Peugeot, 12 reg, in Mullingar. The model, engine, gearbox and body are not recorded. A 2012 Peugeot could be any of several models, so performance, economy and equipment cannot be stated.
priceBasis: No model is recorded, so there is no dealer set to price. Left blank. Checked 24 Nov 2026.

description: 2008 Mercedes-Benz E-Class E220, 08 reg. 2.1 diesel, in Mullingar. The body and gearbox are not recorded, so it could be a saloon or an estate. The E220 CDI of this generation was the 2.1-litre diesel, sold in Classic, Elegance and Avantgarde trims. Wheels and interior differed by trim, so the exact kit depends on the version.
priceBasis: Too thin to price. DoneDeal for E220, 2007–2009, showed private ads only. A 2012 E220 on Carzone is outside the year±1 window. Price left blank rather than padded. Checked 24 Nov 2026.
